presentation_topology.single_cta_resolution: Keep exactly one native SocialUIBinder.bind_render_model(rm) call per Challenge frame. Immediately after it, the D-only consumer applies only targeted visibility decisions to PresentationUI.hook_label, countdown and cta, derived from adapt_native_challenge_render_model; it MUST NOT call SocialUIBinder or PresentationUI.apply_render_model a second time because that would re-run RevealManager and WinningHighlight processing. Mount C11CVisualEditorialLayer once on the existing UnifiedSocialFrame; update its render model each frame without remounting. Hide native CTA only on frames with a non-empty approved D CTA in its CTA source window; otherwise native Challenge CTA remains owner.
